## Visual Structure Description

This is a **pie chart** with 4 sectors, displaying the distribution of responses regarding the preparedness and qualification of specialists for implementing projects according to the "Passive Building" standard. The chart contains the following sectors:

- **Blue (3%)**: "Подготвени и добре квалифицирани са" (Well prepared and qualified)

- **Purple (23%)**: "Няма достатъчно подготвени и квалифицирани специалисти" (Not enough prepared and qualified specialists)

There is no inner circle or comparative data from a previous year visible in the chart.
